reading.body:
CyrusOne's Austin AUS2-AUS3 campus publishes 19 MW of IT load capacity across 242,000 square feet, a scale suited to regulated enterprise workloads rather than hyperscale AI training.

The campus holds PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942 certifications. These signal readiness for financial services, healthcare, and federal tenants, not for unconstrained AI training spend.

Within Texas, the campus ranks tenth by published capacity among 19 facilities with disclosed figures, representing 4 percent of the state's 475 MW of published IT load. Texas has 133 mapped data center facilities, but most publish no capacity, so this ranking covers only a disclosed subset.

At 19 MW, the campus is below the gigawatt scale of hyperscale AI hubs. The published IT load is a ceiling. Actual availability, power delivery headroom for GPU densities, and grid interconnection quality are not published. The suitability score of 62, with announced expansion missing, reflects limited visibility into future capacity.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
